about.text: The buttermilk left in Ethiopia after kibe is churned from ergo, soured milk: drunk as it is, or heated to make ayib cheese.

links.name: Food Science & Nutrition (2024), review of Ethiopian fermented milk products

how.text: Arera is the defatted sour milk left after ergo is churned for butter; it keeps the casein, whey, acidity and aroma of ergo. Heating it curdles out ayib cottage cheese.

links.name: Karssa et al. 2024, Food Sci Nutr (review, Ethiopian fermented milks)
